[Verse 1]
[Db]I will carry you and
give you life
[Fm]I will cover you and
[Eb]show you the way
[Db]It's a sequence that you
never learned
[Fm]It's a lesson I will
[Eb]never forget
[Db]I can hear you in the
overtones
[Fm]Just an echo of the
[Eb]promise we made
[Db]Change the future, we can
travel time
[Fm]Or make us blind so we can
[Eb]never look back

[Pre-Chorus]
[Db]
[Fm]
[Eb]We can never look
[Db]back
[Fm]
[Eb]

[Chorus]
[Db]Hah Hah Hah
I'm the night-sky
[Fm]Hah Hah Hah
[Eb]I'm the fire in your eyes
[Db]Hah Hah Hah
And I want you
[Fm]Now and for
[Eb]all time
[Db]Hah Hah Hah
I'm the cold heart
[Fm]Hah Hah Hah
[Eb]I'm the secret that you hide
[Db]Hah Hah Hah
I'll be listening
[Fm]until you
[Eb]decide

[Verse 2]
[Db]I communicate in
simple strings (take your time)
[Fm]I'm the only one who
[Eb]gave you the truth (speak to me)
[Db]Once you leave me you were
really gone (far and near)
[Fm]Give me something to re-
[Eb]member you by (always be)
[Db]All that's here is what you
left behind (majesty)
[Fm]Slowly moving in the
[Eb]back of my mind (can't forget)
[Db]Take a moment to re-
member me (and our ways)
[Fm]Make me blind so I don't
[Eb]ever look back
